additions.reason: The Torah explicitly equates Shavuot with Sukkot as expressions of the same reality: both are manifestations of Binah, the source from which the Torah emerges. 'Shavuot and Sukkot are one' — they share the same essential nature as two faces of the Binah/Torah-giving dimension. This is unambiguous bechina language.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת שָׁבוּעוֹת, כִּי שָׁבוּעוֹת וְסֻכּוֹת הֵם אֶחָד, כִּי הַתּוֹרָה יוֹצֵאת מִבִּינָה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת סֻכָּה

additions.reason: The bayit (house) built with wisdom is explicitly a bechina of the Sukkah-wisdom domain. The verse 'be-chokhmah yibaneh bayit' (Proverbs 24:3) and the identification of Bereishit's opening beit with bayit show that bayit/house is the same essential reality as the Sukkah's sheltering Binah made manifest in the physical domain. The Torah concludes: 'Yaakov journeyed to Sukkot and built himself a house' — Sukkah leads to bayit; they are bechina of each other.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת: וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכּוֹתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת ... נַעֲשִׂים בְּעַצְמָם בִּבְחִינוֹת הַתּוֹרָה ... וְאָז מַתְחֶלֶת הַתּוֹרָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּרֵאשִׁית, בְּחִינוֹת בַּיִת, הַיְנוּ בֵּית דִּבְרֵאשִׁית

additions.reason: The month of Sivan is explicitly called a 'bechina' of the verse 'Yaakov journeyed to Sukkot and built himself a house' — it is the acronym of that very verse (וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכּוֹתָה וַיִּבֶן). Sivan is thus a bechina of the Sukkah-Torah domain, sharing the same essential nature as the time of Torah-giving that flows from Binah.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת סִוָּון, שֶׁאָז הוּא זְמַן מַתַּן תּוֹרָה, רָאשֵׁי־תֵּבוֹת: וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכּוֹתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת

additions.reason: The opening letter beit of Bereishit is explicitly called a bechina of bayit (house), and bayit is connected back to the Sukkah-wisdom domain ('Yaakov traveled to Sukkot and built a house'). The beit of Bereishit is thus the same essential dimension as the Sukkah — the sheltering, containing wisdom-structure that begins creation and Torah alike.
additions.source_quote: וְאָז מַתְחֶלֶת הַתּוֹרָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּרֵאשִׁית, בְּחִינוֹת בַּיִת, הַיְנוּ בֵּית דִּבְרֵאשִׁית, בְּחִינוֹת: וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכּוֹתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת
